technique_name: Describe the unique characteristics of a dimpled golf ball.
description: A golf ball with dimples has hundreds of tiny indentations or bumps on its surface which creates greater aerodynamic drag, resulting in more lift and a longer flight. Dimpled golf balls also generate more backspin, resulting in improved accuracy and greater distance than those without dimples. The dimples also cause the ball to take a more erratic path, which is beneficial in avoiding obstacles or hazards.
